name: Spinerock Knoll
oracle_text:
Hideaway 4 (When this land enters, look at the top four cards of your library, exile one face down, then put the rest on the bottom in a random order.)
This land enters tapped.
{T}: Add {R}.
{R}, {T}: You may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost if an opponent was dealt 7 or more damage this turn.
blocked_sentences: {R}, {T}: You may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost if an opponent was dealt 7 or more damage this turn.

needs.what: a value reading the GREATEST damage any single opponent was dealt this turn (e.g. {"max_damage_taken_this_turn": "each_opponent"}, or a per-player mode on damage_taken_this_turn), so "if an opponent was dealt 7 or more damage this turn" compares one opponent's total against 7
needs.why_existing_wont_do: damage_taken_this_turn over each_opponent returns the SUM across all opponents (values.py: sum(ledger.damage_taken.get(p) for p in pids)), so 4 damage to each of two opponents wrongly satisfies the 7 threshold in multiplayer; `max` only takes a fixed list of expressions and cannot map over opponents, and wrapping the effect in for_each_player with a per-seat binding would re-offer the free play once per qualifying opponent rather than test a single condition
